hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Fluid end valve and seat
function: The spring-loaded poppet valves and seats in the fluid end that let slurry into the bore on the suction stroke and out on the discharge stroke.

tabs.overview: A valve body with an elastomer insert seals on a hardened seat; the spring closes it between strokes. Proppant cuts the insert and washes the seat, so the sets are changed on a schedule measured in pumping hours.
tabs.engineering: Standard sizes across the fleet; hardened seats; inserts chosen for the fluid.
tabs.safety: Changed with the pump isolated and the fluid end bled.
tabs.evidence: Public equipment overviews (S22), public simultaneous-frac articles (S17, S18, S19), field practice (S9). Rates and horsepower are typical values, not a design basis.
